taskPreset.title: Create README Task
taskPreset.description: Refresh README.md from each repository's shared requirements file, or bring translated READMEs in line with the source.

panel.projectHint: The task session will be created inside the selected project.
panel.commandHint: Choose init to create the requirements file, update to refresh README.md, or translate to bring translated READMEs in line with it.
panel.repositoryScopeHint: Select the repositories to work on. An empty selection means all writable repositories, including the MonoSpecs root.
panel.operationBriefHint: Optional. Extra context for this run. Each repository's index file remains the source of requirements.
panel.taskNameHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the preset default title.

commands.groupDescription: Choose what happens to each repository's README.
commands.updateDescription: Refresh README.md against the repository's requirements file and current repository facts.
commands.translateDescription: Bring each translated README in line with README.md without editing the source.
commands.initDescription: Explore the repository and write its requirements file, and README.md too when it has none.
